# EventWave Event / Venue Promotion commercial intent cluster

Public ID: eventwave-paid-promotion-v1
Problem: An organizer or venue wants a bounded paid EventWave placement with verified payment, source review and controlled activation.
Pricing: Event Boost $49 one-time; Venue Pack $149 one-time.
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Human review: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=eventwave-paid-promotion-v1
Capability contract: /chum/capabilities/eventwave-paid-promotion-v1/

## Boundary

- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout requires explicit human confirmation where supported.
- Paid state requires authoritative provider verification.
